title: Thermal die-cut chips

reference.grammar: die-cut chips on warm gray stock; 1.5 px plum outline misregistered from a white-backed fill; heat-map gradient interiors with liquid sub-layers; two flat orange/black pieces with cut windows and dash-row text; monochrome print grain

units: design units, 1000 = plate width (ref 722 px ⇒ 1 u = 0.722 ref px, 1 ref px = 1.385 u)

techniques.name: Misregistered keyline
techniques.implementation: Every chip is a set of rings; the backing ring is offset +1.4 u along its normals and translated (+1.4,+1.4), the fill ring is offset −1.4 u and translated the same, and the plum line is stroked on the unmoved ring at 2.1 u so a pale hairline shows inside the top-left edges and outside the bottom-right ones.

techniques.name: Warped thermal ramp

params.edge_term: exp(−d/60–70 u) × ±0.12–0.32 on the dial, tab and wedge
params.liquid_contour: one per chip: local slope ×(1+2.5–3·e^(−g²/0.012)) at ramp value 0.36–0.62
params.per_chip: own noise offset (ox,oy) and own ramp subset: pink/white/blue arch, yellow/white/blue tab, blue/white lens, white/pink dial, mostly-blue wedge

techniques.implementation: For each chip an ImageData at 1.6 u pitch evaluates f = perlin(p + warp·q) + 0.3·perlin(2p + …) with q a 2-octave warp, adds a linear ramp along the chip and an optional edge-distance term, stretches by the contrast, steepens the slope locally around one ramp value so a single liquid contour hardens, and looks the result up in a 256-entry pale-biased ramp LUT; the bitmap is drawn smoothed into the fill clip.

techniques.name: Die-cut rings

params.builder: polygon vertices with per-corner radius → arcs at 3 u step
params.holes: evenodd rings (keyhole r 34 + slot 26×110, corners r 6)

techniques.implementation: Each silhouette is a vertex list with corner radii; corners are replaced by tangent-point arcs and the ring is sampled at ~3 u so the same polyline feeds fill, clip, normal offset and stroke.

techniques.name: Flat plate
techniques.implementation: Solid orange fill through the same backing/offset machinery; no gradient, only the closing grain; a mint 1.5 u rule and 3 u dots as fittings.

techniques.name: Cut window with pale rim

params.gradient: blue #0477C8 → black over the top 45 % of the window, only on the large window

techniques.implementation: Cut windows reuse the chip rings: a pale-orange rim ring +1.4 u, then the black (or blue-to-black thermal) fill −1.4 u translated (+1.4,+1.4), so a light hairline sits on the top-left of every cut.

techniques.name: Warm gray stock
techniques.implementation: Flat fill plus a radial 1.5 % darkening from 55 % radius to the corners; the grain pass gives it its tooth.

techniques.name: Liquid layer blob
techniques.implementation: A Fourier-radius blob clipped to the chip fill, filled with its own low-contrast thermal ramp, then outlined with the same slipped keyline so it reads as a second cut layer of liquid.

techniques.name: Print grain
techniques.implementation: One ImageData pass over the composite multiplies R, G and B by 1 + 0.042·(0.6·n(c) + 0.2·n(c−x) + 0.2·n(c−y)) with n a signed hash on 1.385 u cells, giving mono grain with a 0.35 lag-1 correlation like the reference’s.

techniques.name: Ridged marbling

params.weight: 0.65 × smoothstep((u−0.5)·3 − 0.55 + 0.5); only the right ~25 % of the capsule
params.blend: color-space mix with the base ramp

techniques.implementation: On the capsule a second, smaller-scale warped field with its own blue/pale/yellow ramp is mixed in by color where the weight rises along the length, so the right end breaks into a few soft blue and yellow pools while the left stays a smooth pink-to-white plateau.

techniques.name: Dash-row micro text
techniques.implementation: Right-aligned rows of 3–6 orange rectangles of random width with a 4 u gap and 11 u pitch stand in for text; nothing is typed.

pass_order: chip fills: thermal ImageData or flat, clipped to the shrunk slipped ring
liquid layers, cut windows, fittings, dash rows
print grain ImageData pass over all
orange_budget: one flat orange card (#F65C1E), one orange/black device, one small orange disc; every other chip is a gradient with no orange stop
notes: All numbers measured on ref-03.png at 722 px and scaled ×1.385 to 1000 design units.
Reference area shares (k-means): paper 0.39, blue 0.14, orange 0.08, pink 0.06, black 0.05, pale pink 0.04, yellow 0.02, mint 0.015.
Outline profile: 1.5 px dark, white hairline 1 px inside on top/left, 1 px outside on bottom/right ⇒ fill and backing slipped +1 px.
